principle: Treat EVERY object as interrogable AND mutable under alternate realities. Two engines over one taxonomy: (1) object interrogation (object x dimension x spintax); (2) the CONTEXTUAL MUTATION layer (object x context-vector x interrogation-function = variants) — stress-test fitness under geography/industry/customer/scale/infra/regulation/hardware/cost/deployment/business-model; plus the ARCHITECTURAL DECISION matrix (should this exist / live here / compute here / transfer this way at all?). scripts/interrogation_engine.py expands spintax x object_types x SAMPLED context vectors into a bounded, deduped, deterministic candidate set (serves_truth=false). The space is astronomical BY DESIGN — the engine samples + caps + LOGS drops (no silent truncation). Owner framework, 2026-06-25.
placeholder_note: Templates use {object_type} + any context-pool name as {pool}. Multi-pool templates (contextual_fitness) are filled with a sampled CONTEXT VECTOR (each axis varies independently).
governance_note: 'insurance' is intentionally OMITTED from the industry pool per CLAUDE.md (stay away from insurance). Context arrays are for interrogating fitness, not for building real pipelines in restricted domains.

quality: Is this the {best|optimal|ideal|most appropriate|most efficient} way to {implement|build|design|structure} this {object_type}?
Is this {object_type} {overengineered|underengineered|unnecessarily complex|too simple} for what it does?
historical: Is this pattern {becoming obsolete|increasing in popularity} and what replaces it?
industry: How would the {industry} industry build this {object_type} differently (compliance, scale, risk)?
dependency: Can this {object_type}'s dependency be {removed|replaced|upgraded|eliminated} with native features?
maintainability: Can a junior engineer understand this {object_type}? Is the naming correct?
Is technical debt accumulating in this {object_type}?
testing: What {unit|integration|property|chaos|regression} tests should exist for this {object_type}?
What {edge cases|failure modes} are untested here?
concurrency: Is this {object_type} thread-safe; are {race conditions|deadlocks} possible?
Is async handling correct in this {object_type}?
language: Would implementing this {object_type} in {language} improve outcomes?
Is {language} the right choice for this {object_type}?
ai_native: Can this {object_type} become DETERMINISTIC (remove the model from the path)?
failure: What happens if this {object_type} fails; is there {fallback|retry|circuit-breaking}?
What are this {object_type}'s known failure modes + recovery paths?
observability: Can failures in this {object_type} be diagnosed quickly?
cost: Is this {object_type} the cheapest correct way to do this?
version: Why this version of this {object_type}; what {forks|branches} differ and perform better?
What {abandoned forks|historical versions} of this {object_type} exist?
comparative: Compare this {object_type} against the {top open-source|top enterprise|top startup} alternatives.
Which competitor does this {object_type} better, and why?
elimination: Does this {object_type} need to exist; is it duplicate functionality?
constraint: What {assumptions|hidden constraints|implicit dependencies|undocumented behavior} does this {object_type} carry?
Which of this {object_type}'s constraints are artificial?
philosophical: Why does this {object_type} exist; what problem does it solve; is it the wrong problem?
meta: What question have we NOT asked about this {object_type}?
What dimension of this {object_type} remains unexplored?
mutation: What if we {replaced the algorithm|replaced the database|changed the protocol|changed the architecture} of this {object_type}?
Generate a deliberate variant of this {object_type} that is more bounded + cheaper.

What if this {object_type} ran on {a satellite|an embedded device|the edge}?

regulatory_fitness: Would {regulation} force a redesign of this {object_type} (encryption, audit, residency, deployment)?
Is this {object_type} compliant under {regulation} for a {customer_type} customer?
